address: 206/1 Chaloem Phrakiat Ratchakan Thi 9 Road, Prawet, Bangkok, 10250, Thailand
bio: The owner is passionate about bringing the flavours of his native Udon Thani to the capital. In a cool, vintage yet modern space, he delights in pairing wines with Isan cuisine; the head chef, his mother, carefully crafts every dish using ingredients sourced from the province's small towns. The simple 40-item menu offers shareable portions, including a standout Larb Grilled Corn, which combines three types of corn for a unique flavour and texture....
